note: Retained detector evidence figures. Placeholder and conceptual figures were removed; the pre-cleanup manifest is linked from docs/history/README.md. Current access figure provenance is in docs/data-and-figures.md.

figures.boundary: Synthetic scene from make_scene(size=256, seed=1); demonstrates the extractor's behaviour, not performance on real imagery. Since CR-09 (2026-09-16) the red lines are each candidate's delivered path_px (one interior-biased route per accepted component; no branch or junction recovery), not the legacy straight chord.
figures.reproducibility: Deterministic given the seed. Numeric output (scene fingerprint and candidate geometry) is pinned in results/method_demo_synthetic.numeric.json and gated by analysis/tests/test_demo_reproducibility.py. Do NOT gate on PNG bytes: font rasterisation differs between freetype builds, so the text bands change while every data pixel is identical -- see results/method_demo_synthetic.env.json. The rendered path geometry (path_px, path_length_px, candidate ids and order) is pinned in results/extractor_stress_cases.json under cases.demo_reference.exported_paths_px and checked by the same test module; method_demo_synthetic.numeric.json is retained as the legacy chord/scene record.

figures.boundary: Five views of the CR-09 stress cases: the delivered path_px against the legacy endpoints_px chord and each case's reference centerline. Synthetic constructions with known truth; nothing here is imagery or a site result. Panel numbers are read from the v4 stress record, not typed.
figures.reproducibility: Deterministic given the fixed seeds in stress_cases.py. analysis/tests/test_plot_stress_cases.py checks the script runs and writes all five files; pixels are not compared (font rasterisation differs between machines).

figure_comparison_policy.reason: For method-demo-synthetic, a committed-vs-fresh PNG diff shows 1.59% of pixels differing, all of it glyph rasterisation in the title and footer bands; every pixel inside both axes is identical. Comparing bytes would report drift that does not exist, and a real change in the scene or the extracted geometry would be lost in that noise.
figure_comparison_policy.verified_stable_across: numpy 2.1.3 / scipy 1.14.1 and numpy 2.4.6 / scipy 1.17.1 -- same scene sha256, same six candidate endpoints, byte-identical PNG
